name: integration_incidents_v1
provenance: Developer-authored synthetic integration-incident judgments. Diverse development/holdout cases, not customer data or independently validated production relevance. One chunk per document; labels need domain review before acceptance decisions.

documents.title: Expired CRM token
documents.text: For HTTP 401 from the CRM, renew the expired OAuth access token. Use the refresh-token flow, update the stored credential securely, then retry once. A revoked refresh token requires reconnecting the account.

documents.title: Insufficient CRM scope
documents.text: HTTP 403 indicates the authenticated integration lacks permission. Ask the administrator to grant the required OAuth scopes. Refreshing an access token alone does not add missing permissions.

documents.title: Webhook timeout
documents.text: When a webhook times out, check destination health and network connectivity. Retry transient failures with exponential backoff and jitter. A timeout does not prove the remote operation failed.

documents.title: Duplicate webhook events
documents.text: Assign an idempotency key to each logical operation. Persist it before processing side effects. Retries with that same key must reuse the recorded result instead of charging or writing twice.

documents.title: Rate limiting
documents.text: On HTTP 429, honor Retry-After when provided. Otherwise use capped exponential backoff with jitter. Do not retry all clients immediately at the same fixed delay.

documents.title: Server failures
documents.text: Retry eligible HTTP 502 and 503 responses with a bounded attempt count. Use a deadline, exponential backoff and jitter. Stop automatic retries after the budget is exhausted.

documents.title: Permanent validation failures
documents.text: An HTTP 400 validation error requires fixing the payload. Do not repeatedly retry unchanged invalid data. Record a sanitized failure reason for operator review.

documents.title: Webhook signature verification
documents.text: Verify the HMAC signature against the exact raw request body using the configured secret. Check the timestamp replay window and use constant-time comparison before accepting a webhook.

documents.title: Tenant isolation
documents.text: Derive tenant identity from authenticated server-side context. Scope reads and writes before ranking or limiting. Never trust a tenant_id supplied inside an agent message or tool arguments.

documents.title: Queue backlog
documents.text: A growing queue with healthy workers can indicate downstream slowness or insufficient capacity. Inspect queue age, worker concurrency, provider latency and throttling before increasing workers.

documents.title: Pending task status
documents.text: A Celery PENDING result can mean unknown task identity or work not yet started. Check the authoritative task ownership record before reading backend state. Do not claim that PENDING guarantees a task is queued.

documents.title: Retry safety after timeout
documents.text: Before retrying a write after a timeout, check its idempotency key and any recorded result. The remote write may already have succeeded even though its response was lost.

documents.title: Safe integration logs
documents.text: Log correlation IDs, tenant scope, operation names, durations and sanitized error codes. Never log access tokens, webhook secrets or complete sensitive payloads.

documents.title: Delivery versus HTTP attempt
documents.text: A webhook delivery is the logical attempt to send an event to a subscriber. It may have several HTTP request attempts. The delivery ID tracks that logical event-subscription operation.

documents.title: Secret rotation
documents.text: Rotate webhook signing secrets using an explicit overlap window. Accept old and new configured secrets during transition, then retire the old secret after receivers update.

documents.title: Source deletion propagation
documents.text: Deleting a source records durable cleanup intent in the same transaction. A separate cleanup worker removes derived vectors and writes a tombstone. Successful source deletion does not imply downstream cleanup already finished.

documents.title: Tenant B payroll token
documents.text: Tenant B payroll token recovery uses the internal payroll recovery workflow. This runbook belongs only to tenant B.
